inspectionMethod: All four heroes and all thirteen declared previews directly inspected as exact saved images, including the eight actual CSS captures and finite-opening diagnostic. No uninspected alias listed. Four-view/use-size sheets, three backgrounds, integer/fractional logical128 and phone32, both prescribed browser modes covered.
scoreContext: Comparative against the original source and fixed warm-soft target; no universal numeric acceptance threshold. The candidate visibly improves volume and construction, but the localized N opening remains a material visual blocker.
observations: S has fuller softly shaded blue timbers, substantial slate straps and legible pale polygon fasteners. N shows matching rear hardware, and E/W share the same underlying construction and palette. These improve the thin blocks and flat planes of the original. Old part counts and weak geometry were not used as constraints.

Broad highlights and the slate/pale-metal hierarchy are coherent across all four directions. No directional ground cast shadow, glow fringe, blown white highlight or large black material deadspot was observed. Fine native grain and short wear slivers are restrained; the simpler wear pattern is not itself a blocker.

The N joining region currently reads as a short bright horizontal cut on light backgrounds. Each single image has alpha0 at native rows412-413 over x64..92 and291..319; adjoining images make a 58-source-pixel / 29-logical-pixel slit at each internal join. It is flanked by opaque interior timbers, so the negative space is concentrated at the module boundaries rather than reading as a coherent open rail bay.

That slit is directly visible in finite-opening-diagnostic.png, repeated.png and the N/light logical128 CSS captures from both backends, including the fractional case. At phone32 it reduces to a small repeating interruption and is less prominent; this does not resolve the logical128 defect. The same opening in the connected-native control explains its geometric origin and does not establish a clean visible join.

S/E/W independent repeats otherwise read continuously. Native-differences.png and the actual CSS outputs retain small finite-light and exterior precision differences without a separately observed local alpha/filter line comparable to the N geometric slit. All32 retained native canvases compare identically across modes; CSS fractional differences remain separate evidence.

blockers.location: N: immediately below upper rail, native rows412-413, repeated joins around native columns320 and576; strongest on light logical128 integer/fractional fixtures in both browser modes.
blockers.effect: Localized high-contrast horizontal background bars advertise the module cuts and interrupt the otherwise substantial hull construction. In this candidate they do not read as intentional coherent rail separation.
blockers.desiredVisibleOutcome: Keep the exact three finite profiles and full .08 collars. Revise the permitted native interior construction and its negative-space treatment so the unavoidable collar opening has a clear, continuous structural relationship to the rail/bay design, with no isolated seam-like slit at the join at logical128 or phone32. The editor chooses the native form solution; this does not demand solid pixels in a legitimately open frame or authorize filling/changing the locked collars.
blockers.constraints: Preserve all frozen geometry/contact/capture rules. No alpha/RGB repair, overlap, crop/fit, camera/root shift, helper change or post-candidate criterion relaxation.

remainingDifferences: The target has richer painterly edge wear and warmer irregular highlight accents. The candidate uses cleaner long rails, restrained grain and a quieter palette treatment; those differences are nonblocking here provided the N structural opening is resolved.
The target single view does not establish unseen reference views; their shared native construction was judged on coherence rather than literal target matching.

openingResolution.classification: visible localized seam/negative-space readability defect in this exact design; not accepted as coherent intentional opening
openingResolution.geometryFinding: Actual source/candidate disconnected profiles impose an opening; no claim that every source/collar pixel must be opaque.
openingResolution.visualFinding: Interior infill stops the opening around the module ends, producing short bars at repeat cuts. Matching geometry/native reference is not a visual waiver.
openingResolution.revisionScope: Improve the interior design around the same immutable profiles/collars; no contract change or waiver is requested.
